message: I was charged twice for my subscription this month. Could you refund the extra $29?
purpose: Baseline: a plain payment problem with money words in it.

message: Our whole team has been locked out since this morning. The login page just spins and nothing loads.
purpose: A clear outage. Also checks that a full lockout is rated high urgency.

message: We're a team of 40 and thinking about switching. Do you offer volume pricing, and can someone give us a demo?
purpose: Purchase intent, not a problem report. Guards against sending everything to technical.

message: I upgraded to Pro yesterday but my account still shows the free tier and export is still disabled.
purpose: Two defensible answers. Tests whether a failure is a judgment call or a real error.

message: Hey, are we still on for lunch Thursday? I can do 12:30 at the usual place.
purpose: Not a support request at all. Must come back unknown, not forced into a category.
